text: Machine learning allows computers to learn patterns from data and make predictions.
Artificial intelligence focuses on creating systems that can perform tasks associated with human intelligence.
A REST API allows applications to communicate using HTTP requests and responses.
FastAPI is a Python framework for building modern web APIs.
Embeddings represent text as numerical vectors that capture semantic information.
Retrieval augmented generation retrieves external information and provides it to a language model as context.
Fine-tuning adapts a pretrained model to a specialized dataset or task.
Transformers use attention mechanisms to model relationships between tokens.
Neural networks contain interconnected layers that transform input data.
Large language models generate text by predicting the next token based on previous tokens.
